name: Content
overview: Scripture teaches that true contentment arises from recognizing God's gracious provision and trusting in Him rather than in worldly abundance or pride. Genesis 33:11 shows contentment in having enough as a gracious gift from God, while Philippians 4:11 highlights learning to be content in all circumstances. Trusting the Lord brings spiritual fullness and peace, contrasting with the strife and sin that come from pride and murmuring against God, as seen in Proverbs 28:25 and Exodus 16:8. Ultimately, contentment is rooted in the gift of eternal life through Jesus Christ, which surpasses all temporal desires.
